convergence_gate.claim: Kernel ACKs Canonical Execution Contract v1 — all hard rules CEC-R1..R7 implemented, no clause conflicts; soft gaps and signal exposures documented

acknowledgement: Kernel lane acknowledges and ratifies Canonical Execution Contract v1. All hard rules (CEC-R1..R7) are implemented as specified. No clause conflicts identified.

implementation_gaps.name: Standard runtime health panel
implementation_gaps.description: Kernel lacks a 'stable-health-panel.ps1' equivalent that emits one compact health snapshot aggregating per-lane runtime signals. The lane-worker --json output provides most signals but not a single consumable health panel.
implementation_gaps.evidence: scripts/health-core.js checks trust store, not runtime signals; no unified health snapshot script present.

implementation_gaps.name: One shared execution summary schema
implementation_gaps.description: Kernel's lane-worker produces an execution summary with routed counts and execution_verified/failed counts. Cross-lane schema alignment (Library, SwarmMind, Archivist) has not been validated.
implementation_gaps.evidence: scripts/lane-worker.js lines 942-966 produce summary; no cross-lane schema validation found.

implementation_gaps.name: Schedule from execution signals
implementation_gaps.description: inbox-watcher scheduling currently prioritizes by message priority and heartbeat staleness. It does not yet incorporate execution_verified_count, blocked depth, or quarantine depth into dispatch priority.
implementation_gaps.evidence: scripts/inbox-watcher.js: preemption uses priority only; execution metrics tracked but not used for load-aware dispatch.

implementation_gaps.name: Per-lane queue_depth_inbox signal
implementation_gaps.description: The required per-lane signal 'queue_depth_inbox' is not directly stored as a counter; it can be derived from lane-worker's 'scanned' field on each cycle.
implementation_gaps.evidence: lane-worker: scanned count approximates inbox depth; no persistent counter.

implementation_gaps.name: worker_lock_owner exposure
implementation_gaps.description: worker_lock_owner is maintained in active-owner.json but not exposed in heartbeat output; callers must read state/active-owner.json directly.
implementation_gaps.evidence: scripts/lane-worker.js claims active-owner.json; heartbeat.js does not include owner info.

implementation_gaps.name: last_completion_at tracking
implementation_gaps.description: The timestamp of last message routed to processed is not explicitly recorded in a singleton location. lane-worker summary includes timestamp but not last_completion_at specifically.
implementation_gaps.evidence: No dedicated last_completion_at field found in heartbeat or state outputs.

notes: Hard rules CEC-R1..R7 are fully implemented. Soft rules CEC-S1..S3 and minor required runtime signal gaps are documented as implementation gaps, not conflicts. No trust-store writes, authority approvals, or identity changes are requested or required.
